I'm Precious Peter  a Nigerian author and satirist my work sits at the intersection of fantasy romance, campus life, and contemporary fiction.

 Author of : THE STAR WEAVER, Secret Beneath The Campus, Price of Us, Love Is The Ultimate Legacy, Billionaire's Girlfriend, After School, The Ashwood Blood, and Petal of the Shead.

With a voice that blends sharp wit, vivid world-building, and raw cultural honesty, I documents the resilience of young Nigerians — from love that defies destiny to secrets buried beneath university walls. My debut satirical series, Epistle of the empty pot (University student wahala), established my signature style: turning sapa, strikes, and survival into stories that make you laugh, cry, and stay up all night reading.

Available for collaborations, ghostwriting, and publishing opportunities.

Hi, I’m Winny — a writer, storyteller, and English student who believes that every person has a story worth telling.

I’m currently a part-time 500-level English student at Ambrose Alli University, Nigeria. My love for writing began with my fascination with people, emotions, experiences, and the little moments that often become the biggest stories.

I enjoy writing stories and articles that are relatable, engaging, and thought-provoking. I’m particularly drawn to human experiences, relationships, personal growth, everyday life, and stories that leave readers feeling something long after they finish reading.

Beyond storytelling, I’m also exploring content writing, digital marketing, and technology, including blockchain and Web3. These interests continue to shape the way I think about communication and the power of words in the digital world.

As a growing writer, I’m here to learn, experiment, and become better with every piece I create. I want my writing to entertain, connect, inspire, and sometimes make readers pause and see ordinary things from a different perspective.

Welcome to my little corner of stories and words. I hope you find something here that speaks to you. ✍🏽✨
